Thus `SimilarityProfile.X h p = p.2.1`; `hs` makes its logarithm smooth locally, and `hf` supplies the needed regularity of `f`. This can be deleted while retaining `hh`. If `h ≥ 1 / 2`, `SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ` takes its fallback value `1`, since its active branch requires `2 * h < 1`. Hence `SimilarityProfile.X h p = p.2.1`; as `hs` gives `p.2.1 > 0`, composing `hf` with the locally smooth logarithm gives the required regularity.
